generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a slender tree with a narrow, open crown, alternate oval, toothed leaves and hanging catkins. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 16 m tall and 25 cm across at breast height at 40 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: green leaves; white bark peeling in papery strips. Fruit (plant roadmap P4), as in mid-July: slender hanging fruiting catkins 3 to 5 cm long, green going brown. Its year (appearance.organs.bloom.season) is authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands: catkins in April and May; the fruiting catkins green in summer, brown in August and September, breaking up in the autumn. The forest's packages show day 196 (mid-July) until the phenology of plant roadmap P5 sets the day from the date and the local climate.
